scope: Correct station-mode persistence while DHCP is pending and retire a recovered failure latch. 47 adapted platform cases, four real factory/native QEMU network cases, 23 evidence rejections and the existing real RV32 event oracle. No full-suite,24-hour or physical-RF acceptance.

factory_instruction_ranges.meaning: Wait for SDK bits1/2 indefinitely; prefer success.
Save mode2 and restart after failure.

before.scope: Delay only the external Ethernet backend while the real Wi-Fi radio associates.

after.scope:
Compare real station DHCP waiting without replacing Wi-Fi, TCP/IP or firmware.

The built-in QEMU filter buffers external Ethernet replies while the radio still
associates normally. Only disposable synthetic settings and network delivery are
changed; guest RAM, registers, instructions and archived images stay untouched.

platform.scope: Production worker/driver code with deterministic ESP-IDF adapters; no real RF, scheduling, electrical or TLS validation.

network_machine.scope:
Execute original and rebuilt RV32 station events and the original active loop.

Synthetic DHCP leases and Wi-Fi events enter the actual compiled handlers. SDK
connect/notification/HTTP lifecycle and IPv4 formatting are boundaries; field
selection, cache, counters and native address formatting remain machine code.
The bounded original main-loop slice records dispatch, without substituting its
branches. This is not a radio, whole FreeRTOS scheduler or live QEMU link test.

harness_corrections: The first one-off probe misread the HMP backend tree prefix; its VM was stopped and the parser corrected.
Static link-down cannot be changed after realize; the unavailable-AP probe instead uses the supported station-ap-online runtime property.
limitations: This candidate is isolated on codex/small-tv-wifi-fallback; the main full/H10 runs still belong to image8304 and must not be relabeled.
